links.outcome: Ratings of medical validity (healthcare professionals) and empathy (healthcare and nonhealthcare professionals) on 5-point Likert scales
links.effect: Physician-AI collaborative responses were rated significantly higher than physician-only responses on all three prespecified primary outcomes. Differences were larger for empathy than for medical validity. No numeric values were reported in the abstract.
links.quote: In the primary analyses, physician-AI collaborative responses received significantly higher ratings than both physician-only and AI-only responses across all three prespecified primary outcomes.

links.comparator_used: AI-only chatbot responses with no physician revision
